import itertools
import time
from pysat.formula import CNF
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3

start = time.time()
N = 64
def var(t, p):
    return t * N + p + 1

cnf = CNF()

# Exactly one position per time
for t in range(N):
    clause = [var(t, p) for p in range(N)]
    cnf.append(clause)
    for p1, p2 in itertools.combinations(range(N), 2):
        cnf.append([-var(t, p1), -var(t, p2)])

print("Time after time constraints:", time.time() - start)
print("Clauses so far:", len(cnf.clauses))

# Exactly one time per position
for p in range(N):
    clause = [var(t, p) for t in range(N)]
    cnf.append(clause)
    for t1, t2 in itertools.combinations(range(N), 2):
        cnf.append([-var(t1, p), -var(t2, p)])

print("Time after position constraints:", time.time() - start)
print("Clauses so far:", len(cnf.clauses))

# Transition constraints - optimized
def is_knight_move(a, b):
    ra, ca = divmod(a, 8)
    rb, cb = divmod(b, 8)
    dr = abs(ra - rb)
    dc = abs(ca - cb)
    return (dr*dc == 2) and (dr + dc == 3)

for t in range(N-1):
    for a in range(N):
        for b in range(N):
            if not is_knight_move(a, b):
                cnf.append([-var(t, a), -var(t+1, b)])

print("Time after transition constraints:", time.time() - start)
print("Total clauses:", len(cnf.clauses))

# Fixed
fixed = {0:0, 2:27, 3:21, 10:16, 11:1, 19:24, 21:3, 27:51, 38:38, 50:43, 51:60, 59:53, 61:42}
for t_val, p_val in fixed.items():
    cnf.append([var(t_val, p_val)])

print("Time after fixed:", time.time() - start)
print("Final clauses:", len(cnf.clauses))

# Now solve with higher timeout
solver = Glucose3(bootstrap_with=cnf.clauses, use_timer=True)
print("Solver initialized, starting solve...")
sat = solver.solve()
print("Solve completed in", solver.time(), "seconds")
if sat:
    print("SAT found")
    model = solver.get_model()
    sol = [-1] * N
    for t in range(N):
        for p in range(N):
            if model[var(t, p) - 1] > 0:
                sol[t] = p
                break
    print(sol)
    # Verify
    print("Starts with 0:", sol[0] == 0)
    print("Unique:", len(set(sol)) == N)
else:
    print("UNSATISFIABLE")
